_purpose: Sprint 7d (ADR-0024) part C — labeled real-corpus pairs for `php artisan succession:gold-eval`. The failure metric is CONFIDENTLY-WRONG SUCCESSOR: a pair labeled coexisting_sibling or conflict that the rule calls successor. That is the one output that would tempt a human to retire a live document. `uncertain` on a true successor is a MISS, not a failure — the human still has the 7a expiry task and candidate list.
_status: CONFIRMED against the staging corpus (hr_platform on hr-staging-db), 2026-09-06. Every document_id below was verified by SQL (id, title, convenio numero, validity_start/end, retrieval_status) and cross-checked against `succession:gold-eval --discover` output on the same corpus — 19 same-convenio pairs examined, 3 successor claims made, all 3 labeled here, plus one conflict pair and one prose-vs-table-annex sibling pair. Each reference is still FINGERPRINT-GUARDED: the eval trusts `document_id` only when `title_contains` also matches, and SKIPS otherwise, so a stale id in another environment can never make the eval silently score the wrong document.

_labels.successor: the candidate is a later version of the same convenio text — the expiring document's replacement
_labels.coexisting_sibling: same convenio, different subject or different document kind (a salary table beside a prose text, a partial agreement beside a full text) — both stay live
_labels.conflict: same convenio, overlapping subject, but the validity dates do not establish which supersedes which

pairs._why: Same convenio numero (99008825011994), consecutive non-overlapping windows (2020-2023 → 2024-2027), expiring is `historical` and the candidate is the `active` text. A textbook version succession: the 2024-2027 text IS the replacement. Discover measured overlap 0.99821.

Same convenio numero (46000805011981), consecutive non-overlapping windows (2021-2023 → 2024-2026), historical → active. Discover measured overlap 0.890335 — the LOWEST of the three true successors on this corpus, so it is the pair that actually constrains hr.succession_overlap_threshold from above.
Same convenio numero (20100035012014), consecutive non-overlapping windows (2020-2024 → 2025-2028), historical → active. Discover measured overlap 1.0.

The conflict pair the provisional fixture could not name from deploy.md. Two documents of convenio 48006185012006 with the SAME validity window (2022-01-01 → 2025-12-31) and near-identical text (discover measured 0.987517) — in fact a duplicate ingest of the same convenio text (source filenames differ only by a trailing underscore). High overlap with no strictly-later validity_start MUST come out `conflict`, never `successor`: nothing here establishes which supersedes which. Note both documents share the same title, so this pair is resolved by document_id — exactly the case the fingerprint guard exists for (id trusted only because the title fingerprint also matches).

This corpus's version of the pair that must never come out `successor`. Convenio 31005105011984 holds the full prose text (id 30, 2019-2025, now historical) and a salary-table annex published as its own PDF (id 33, 'Tabla 2025', ACTIVE, NULL validity — typed convenio_text, not salary_tables, because the ingestor only forces the salary type for .xlsx). A table annex is not a new version of the whole prose convenio: if the rule called this `successor`, a human might retire the prose text and lose every non-salary answer for that province×sector. EXPECTED OUTCOME ON THIS CORPUS: the rule returns `conflict`, not `coexisting_sibling` — overlap 0.818874 is above hr.succession_overlap_threshold but the candidate has NULL validity_start, so the strictly-later conjunct fails and the rule declines to claim succession. That is a MISS in the cautious direction (bucketed `other_wrong`), not a confidently-wrong successor. It is kept labeled `coexisting_sibling` deliberately: the human label is what it is, and the eval should keep reporting the gap rather than be re-labeled to make the number look clean.

_discover_coverage_note: `--discover --limit 25` examined 19 documents with a validity_end in multi-document convenios on this corpus. 3 successor claims (all labeled above), 8 conflict claims (the 3 successors' reverse direction, the Bizkaia duplicate in both directions, plus 3 pairs whose candidate has NULL validity: Alava Ocio Educativo 63→56, Navarra Intervencion Social 41→52, Navarra Oficinas 30→33), and 8 documents where nothing was proposed at all because the expiring document has no comparable chunks — the salary .xlsx/table PDFs that are never embedded by design (ADR-0006: salary lives in SQL, not vectors). No successor claim was made that a human would call wrong.
